_how: Wednesday Psalm Reels go through the whole Psalter (Septuagint numbering, public-domain LXX2012 text), Psalm 1 to 151, one each week from 'start'. Long psalms are split into parts of about 'max_chars_per_reel' characters (roughly a one-minute Reel), so nothing repeats until the whole Psalter has been read. See the rotation with: python3 -m social.psalm_plan --list. To choose the psalm for one particular Wednesday, add it under 'dates', e.g. "2026-12-23": {"name": "Psalm 50", "from": 1, "to": 10}. To change the order, add an 'order' list of psalm names.
